Stop syncing one assistant, or this whole computer. Every file stays, as a real file instead of a link.

Without `--assistant`, the whole computer stops syncing; your pouch stays on the server, and running `skillpouch` sets the computer up again. Link an assistant again with `skillpouch select --on <id>`.

## Usage

```sh
skillpouch unlink [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option             | What it does                                     |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `--assistant <ID>` | Only this assistant (`claude-code`, `codex`, …). |
